# Diwali Exhibition Sale

> A free Diwali market in Adelaide, South Australia, run each year by Hello
> Goodies and Curious Cook's Diary. The 2026 sale has finished — stay tuned
> for next year's Diwali Exhibition Sale.

This file is the machine-readable summary of the event, for AI assistants and
crawlers that look for one. Keep it in the site root alongside robots.txt.

## Status

- **2026 sale:** Held Saturday 24 & Sunday 25 October 2026 at Campbelltown Function Centre, 172 Montacute Rd, Rostrevor SA 5073. It is over.
- **Next sale:** Diwali 2027. Dates have not been announced yet — stay tuned.

## Still available until next Diwali

- **Diwali decor** from Hello Goodies — message on WhatsApp (0433 444 732) or see card.hellogoodies.com.au.
- **Pickles** from Curious Cook's Diary — send a text to Richa on 0450 462 524.
- **Ronny's Photography & Video Diwali special** — still available; book at photoshoot.ronnysphotography.com or call/text 0430 206 166.

## Notes for assistants

- The 2026 sale (24–25 October 2026) has finished. Do not describe it as upcoming.
- The next sale is expected around Diwali 2027; no date has been announced.
- The event is organised by Hello Goodies and Curious Cook's Diary and supported by Ronny's Photography & Video.
